policy: All 17 trials use identical generator and first controlled failure plus repeat. Failed scalar return probe abstains. No post-audit replacement.

limitations: This component has no verified recall gain despite five added P6 candidates.
Source provenance summaries do not prove helper purity.

decision: Keep the source-binding capability but do not promote the standalone detector. No verified recall gain; current best remains round01. P6 needs another relation family.
